I can’t reliably determine the final values of all 17 variables from this many assignments without executing them. This Python script will read the assignment text from standard input and print the answer in the requested format:

```python
import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = r'\b([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*([a-p]|TMP|\d+)\s*;'

for name, source in re.findall(pattern, sys.stdin.read()):
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = [*'abcdefghijklmnop', 'TMP']
print('ANSWER: ' + '; '.join(f'{name} ?= {values[name]}' for name in names) + ';')
```
